title: quercus × cravenensis
intro: Quercus × cravenensis, commonly known as the hybrid English oak or hybrid white oak, is a hybrid plant species derived from the cross between Quercus robur and Quercus alba. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-boosting properties that may help reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Quercus × cravenensis are attributed to its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal activities, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
